verdict.rationale: Notte's core offering is natural-language operation: users give web agents plain-language tasks ('Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt.'). The docs include a concrete prompt example, and the GitHub README confirms agents take natural-language tasks. One community user reported a failed extraction on a single site, which signals limits on reliability rather than contradicting the capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of successful natural-language task execution, in-depth documentation of the natural-language agent interface and its limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
